notes: Motion controls (gyro/tilt): the built-in GBA player now feeds your phone's gyroscope and accelerometer into the emulator, so cartridge-motion games like WarioWare: Twisted! (and tilt games like Yoshi Topsy-Turvy / Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble) respond to physically rotating/tilting the phone. Android + iOS; desktop has no motion sensor.
